[*]Как установить Перевод?
[/list]   [i][b]Установка:[/b][/i]
1)Установите [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url] 2)Установите [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]NPC Adventures (It's time to adventure)[/url]
